title: If you accidentally double-hit the ball
question: If you accidentally hit the golf ball twice in one swing, what is the rule?

choices.text: No penalty – it only counts as one stroke

explanation: If you hit the ball twice in one swing by accident, it only counts as one stroke and there is no penalty.

juniorVersion.title: What happens if you hit the ball twice by mistake?
juniorVersion.question: When you swing your club and hit the ball, but your club touches it again in the same swing by accident, what should you do?

choices.text: No penalty – it only counts as one hit
Add one extra shot to your score
Add two extra shots to your score

juniorVersion.explanation: If you hit the ball twice in one swing and did not mean to, it is just one shot with no extra penalty.

vocabulary.simpleMeaning: The motion you make when you move the club to hit the ball.
A stroke is one hit at the ball. It is how we count your score.

juniorVersion.teachingTip: After explaining, let juniors try swinging their club (without a ball) to show how a double hit can accidentally happen, so they see it's just part of learning.
likelyMisconceptions: Some juniors may think they have to add a penalty or hit the ball again.
Some may think both hits must be counted. Remind them: it is only one stroke.
